schema.description: The ShiftPlan key is the canonical `siteCode`; `buildingId` is its DEPRECATED alias (same value; ADR 0035). Send at least one. Both present with different values is rejected with 422 conflicting-site-and-building. Send `charge` (the DEPRECATED charge-based proposal) or omit it and name `shiftId` (the proposal from warehouse-planning's published labour plan, ADR 0043).

siteCode.description: The canonical Site code (the facility-layout Site code, e.g. WH1) the proposal is for. Required unless the deprecated buildingId is sent.

buildingId.description: DEPRECATED -- use siteCode. Alias of siteCode with the same value. Required only when siteCode is not sent.

shiftId.description: OPTIONAL (ADR 0043). The shift whose published labour plan to read. Used only when `charge` is omitted: the proposal is then the heads warehouse-planning published for (siteCode, shiftId, pathId), untrimmed; nothing published is 404 labour-plan-not-found. Ignored when `charge` is sent.

charge.description: DEPRECATED (ADR 0043 decision 3): the volume of work (units) to be covered on this path; a request with it behaves exactly as before. Omit it and name `shiftId` to get the published requirement instead. Omitting both `charge` and `shiftId` (or sending a null charge without a shiftId) is rejected with a 400 missing-charge problem; an explicit 0 is a valid "nothing to do" charge.

plannedRate.description: Planned units-per-head-per-hour throughput rate for this path. OPTIONAL: omit (or send <= 0) to let the proposal fall back to a real measured rate fed back from labor-performance for this path's task type (feature: close-the-loop measured rate, ADR-0012; its mean seconds per task is converted to units per head per hour as 3600 / meanActualSeconds, ADR-0033). A supplied plannedRate always wins outright over any measured rate.

fromLabourPlan.summary: Heads from warehouse-planning's published labour plan (ADR 0043)
